{{Quote|Get on Representative Alauni's good side. Though between us, I'm not certain she ''has'' one.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] to the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Alauni''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the war, Alauni was among those who joined the [[Rift Alliance]] to protest what they perceived as the incompetence of the Galactic Republic.<ref>{{TORCite|type=codex|The Rift Alliance (Consular)}}</ref>
